title: Magaalaa Yerootti Amanne
intro: Seenaa araara waaqayyoo keessatti hawaasni jijjiiramni isaa yeroo waloo dhugoomsuu ture jira. Seenaa isaanii saaxiluudhaaf jirta-oduu akeekkachiisaa, gaabbii fi yeroo turtii hiree saboota biroo irraa adda isaan godhu.
clues: Ummata ergamaan itti ergamu waan turreef, jalqaba waamicha isaa irraa garagalle.
Mallattoon adabbii dhufuuf jiru yommuu ifa taʼu, akeekkachiisni isaa dhugaa taʼuusaa hubanneerra.
Towbaa garaa qulqulluudhaan gara Gooftaa keenyaatti deebine, amantiin keenyas fudhatama argate.
Adabbiin nurratti murtaa’ee ture sababa amantaa keenyaan ka’e.
Seenaan keenya magaalota adabbii erga arganii booda amanan keessaa akka waan adda ta’etti caqasameera.
Nuti namoota raajii qurxummii galaanaatiin liqimfame sanaa turre, ta’us badiisa irraa baraaramne.
